channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-opentofu
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: tfautomv — via awesome-opentofu
item.description: CLI that automatically generates moved blocks and state-move commands for refactoring Terraform/OpenTofu configurations.

item.title: terraform-tui — via awesome-opentofu
item.description: Terminal UI for browsing, applying, and managing Terraform/OpenTofu state and plans interactively.

item.title: pre-commit-terraform — via awesome-opentofu
item.description: Collection of pre-commit git hooks for validating, formatting, and documenting Terraform and OpenTofu code.

item.title: c3x — via awesome-opentofu
item.description: Cost estimates for OpenTofu code, including .tofu files and provider for_each, posted as a pull request comment.

item.title: TerraVision — via awesome-opentofu
item.description: Generate cloud architecture diagrams with official AWS, Azure and GCP icons from OpenTofu or Terraform code.

item.title: KICS — via awesome-opentofu
item.description: Open-source static analysis tool that finds security vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in IaC, including OpenTofu.

item.title: Checkov — via awesome-opentofu
item.description: Static analysis tool that scans Terraform and OpenTofu templates for security and compliance misconfigurations.

item.title: bare-devcontainer/templates — via awesome-opentofu
item.description: Security-focused Terraform dev container with terraform-ls and rebuild-friendly caching. The base image is available at bare-devcontainer/images.

item.title: opentofu-updater-action — via awesome-opentofu
item.description: Keeps OpenTofu and Terraform providers, modules, Helm charts and container images up to date by opening pull requests.
